aria: Animated recap of the Clippers' 113 to 112 home win over the Thunder: Darius Garland's and-one layup with 50.4 seconds left that turned a 112 to 110 deficit into a 113 to 112 lead, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Garland's 24 points and 7 assists, the top scorers, how the Clippers won, and the next game at home against Charlotte.
notes: Box score from the Clippers' 113–112 home win over the Oklahoma City Thunder at Intuit Dome on Nov 13, 2026 (an NBA Cup group game), from the Covers.com box score, with game details from News9, The Sporting Tribune, Field Level Media, The Oklahoman and OKC Thunder Wire (both via Yahoo Sports) and Yardbarker. All 113 Clippers points and all 112 Thunder points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals: 57–44 Clippers at the half, 84–82 Thunder after three. Team totals (threes 16 of 41 to 11 of 35, free throws 17 of 21 to 13 of 19, rebounds 40–45, blocks 7–4, points in the paint 40–58) and the biggest leads (Clippers 15, Thunder 7) are from Covers.com. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Friday's games.

Oklahoma City opened the second half on a 19–6 run to tie it at 63 with 7:28 left in the third and won the quarter 40–25; Jared McCain's long 3-pointer at the buzzer made it 84–82 (The Sporting Tribune; The Oklahoman). Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's 3-pointer with 3:01 left made it 110–106 and the Thunder led 112–106 with 2:43 left (News9). The Clippers scored the last 7 points: Brook Lopez inside at 2:21 and a Lopez pull-up jumper (Field Level Media), then Garland's three-point play (News9; Field Level Media). Gilgeous-Alexander missed a jumper at the buzzer (News9; The Oklahoman). It was Oklahoma City's third straight loss and its first three-game losing streak since April 2024 (News9). The Clippers host Charlotte on Sunday, Nov 15 at 4:30 PM ET (Yardbarker).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Darius Garland's three-point play with 50.4 seconds left (News9; Field Level Media), with the Clippers down 112–110 (OKC Thunder Wire): Garland drove downhill at McCain and finished the layup through contact, then made the free throw for the 113–112 final (OKC Thunder Wire; The Sporting Tribune). The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the LA Clippers or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The player in the play of the game is drawn to Garland’s listed 6-foot-1 and 192 pounds (Basketball-Reference), in the Clippers' home white with No. 10 (Land of Basketball). No wingspan from a reliable measurement is reported, so his arms are drawn at a 1.0 ratio. He has no approved look on file yet, so he is drawn as a team-colour silhouette in the kit. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
